πολιῆς: πολιός — grey (of the sea); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)

πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πύματον: πύματος — last, final; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.: οὐδέ πῃ ’not in any way’
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’)
σπεύδετον: σπεύδω — hasten, press on; pres. imper. 2 dual act.: ’(you two) hasten!’
στεινωπῷ: στεινωπός — narrow; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic στενωπός), agreeing with ὁδῷ
στεῖνος: στεῖνος — narrow place, narrowness (= Attic στένος); neut. nom. sg., predicate
στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’mouth’ (κεφαλὴ στόμα τε ῥῖνές τε ’head and mouth and nostrils’) · also the point of a weapon: ’tip’ (κατὰ στόμα … χαλκῷ ’at the tip, with bronze’)
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic σφίσιν): ’among them, to them’
σφῶϊ: σφώ — you two; dual pron., epic σφῶϊ, acc.: ’you two’ · also nom. dual: ’you two’ (σφῶϊ μέν ’as for you two’)
σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’of you two’ · also dat. dual, of interest or place: ’in you two, to you two’ (σφῶϊν ἐν γούνεσσι ’in your knees’)
σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε that follows · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σύν ῥ’ ἔβαλον = συνέβαλον ’dashed together’)
σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθείς: ’a sign, an omen’ · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’tomb’ (παρ’ Ἴλου σῆμα ’past the tomb of Ilus’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’ · also plpf. pass. 3 sg. as a copula with a predicate adj.: ’was, had come to be (the best)’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’)
ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg.
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἦεν: ’would have been fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἐστίν: ’is a thing to be fulfilled’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τιταίνετον: τιταίνω — stretch, draw, pull; pres. 3 dual act.: ’the two pull’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοσοῦτον: τοσοῦτος — so great, so much; masc. acc. sg. (Attic form; epic τόσος, τόσσος)
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’ · also masc. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that (old man)’ · also plain possessive gen.: ’his’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἀπό, of separation: ’from him’ (ἀπὸ τοῖο ’from him’)
τροχὸν: τροχός — wheel, round disc; masc. acc. sg.
τρωϊκὸν: Τρωϊκός — Trojan, of Troy; adj., neut. acc. sg., with πεδίον (= Attic Τρωικός)
τρώϊοι: Τρώϊος — Trojan; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic Τρωικός): ’Trojan’
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδεω: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus (patronymic of Diomedes); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
τυδεΐδην: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. acc. sg. (patronymic)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with οὔ τι: ’so much’ (οὔ τι τόσον ’not so much’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with a verb of coming: ’so greatly’ (τόσον ἵκει ’comes so greatly’) · also neut. acc. sg. adj., agreeing with κακόν and correlative with ὅσσον: ’so great’ (κακὸν τόσον ὅσσον ’an evil so great as’)
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’so great’ (τόσσον μένος)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι)
υἷϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
φάμεν: φημί — say, speak; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἔφαμεν): ’we said’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’
φηρητιάδαο: Φηρητιάδης — son of Pheres (patronymic; usually taken to be Admetus); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φοῖνιξ: Φοῖνιξ — Phoenix, Achilles’ old tutor; masc. nom. sg. · also φοῖνιξ, a Phoenician; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’Phoenix!’ (Φοῖνιξ ἄττα ’father Phoenix’)
φύγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔφυγον)
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’ · also fem. gen. pl. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hands’ (θρασειάων ἀπὸ χειρῶν ’from the bold hands’)
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
χωομένοιο: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο
χύτο: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, passive sense (= Attic ἐχύθη): ’was poured, was shed’
χῶρον: χῶρος — place, spot, space; masc. acc. sg.
ἀΐοντι: ἀΐω — hear, perceive; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἀκούοντι): ’as he heard’
ἀγὸς: ἀγός — leader, commander; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγῶνι: ἀγών — gathering, place of assembly; masc. dat. sg., of place with ἐν
ἀερσίποδες: ἀερσίπους — lifting the feet high (ἀείρω + πούς), the usual explanation, sense not quite certain; masc. nom. pl., epithet of horses
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard, + acc. of what is said); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard’
ἀλεείνων: ἀλεείνω — shun, avoid; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμείνονες: ἀμείνων — better, braver (comparative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. pl.
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀνάσσει: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
ἀνασταδόν: ἀνασταδόν — standing up, rising to one’s feet; adv. (from ἀνίστημι)
ἀντίλοχ: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀντίλοχ’ = Ἀντίλοχε), in address
ἀντίλοχος: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντιλόχῳ: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. dat. sg.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖοι — Argives, Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀριπρεπέα: ἀριπρεπής — very conspicuous, outstanding; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with παῖδ’ · also neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with ἄστρα: ’outstanding’
ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου) · also son of Atreus, i.e. Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀφραδέως: ἀφραδέως — senselessly, thoughtlessly; adv. (ἀ- privative + φράζομαι ’consider’)
ἀφῆκεν: ἀφίημι — let go, let fly, hurl; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’let fly’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also ἅλς (masc.) — salt; masc. gen. sg., partitive: ’of salt’
ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’ · also ἂμ before φ, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂμ φόνον ’up through the slaughter’)
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄτερ: ἄτερ — apart from, without; prep. + gen.
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μιν: ’the whole of it’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’all (the sorrows)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τά: ’all (these things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’all (the army)’
ἐΐκτην: ἔοικα — be like, seem; plpf. 3 dual, epic (= Attic ᾑκέτην), + dat.: ’the two were like’
ἐβεβήκει: βαίνω — go, step; plpf. 3 sg. act., with simple past force: ’had set out, was gone’
ἐγγύς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv., with a gen. as a preposition: ’near’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
ἐλαύνειν: ἐλαύνω — drive, ride; pres. inf. act.: ’to drive’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνένιπεν: ἐνίπτω (aor. ἐνένιπον) — rebuke, chide; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’rebuked’
ἐνῆκεν: ἐνίημι — send in, put into; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’put (into)’
ἐξάλμενος: ἐξάλλομαι — leap out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (= ἐξαλάμενος): ’having leapt out’
ἐξέφερον: ἐκφέρω — carry out, bear out; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented after the preverb: ’were bearing out’
ἐξεκυλίσθη: ἐκκυλίω — roll out; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was rolled out, tumbled out’
ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπειγόμενοι: ἐπείγομαι — press on, be hard pressed, hasten; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’hard pressed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐφομαρτεῖτον: ἐφομαρτέω — keep pace with, accompany; pres. imper. 2 dual act., contracted: ’(you two) keep pace!’
ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’willingly’
ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
ἔβαλεν: βάλλω — throw, hurl, strike; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’threw’ (κὰδ … ἔβαλεν = κατέβαλεν ’laid low’)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
ἔκφερον: ἐκφέρω — carry out, bear off; impf. 3 pl. act.: ’were carrying off’
ἔλαυνε: ἐλαύνω — drive; impf. 3 sg., without the lengthened augment (= Attic ἤλαυνε): ’drove’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drive’
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔσχετο: ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; mid. hold before oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’held (before him)’ · also with ὑπό in tmesis (ὑπό … ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο): ’promised’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’leaders!’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject of ἧντ’: ’leaders (were sitting)’
ἡνίοχον: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. acc. sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg.
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’)
ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν): ’to see’
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενεῦ: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. voc. sg.
ἰούσας: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. fem. acc. pl.: ’coming’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἵππειον: ἵππειος — of a horse, horse-; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λόφον: ’horsehair’
ἵπποις: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., object of ἕπομαι (+ dat.): ’horses’ · also masc. dat. pl., of accompaniment: ’with the horses’ (ἵπποις ἀΐσσων ’darting with the horses’)
ἵπποισι: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
ἵππον: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. sg., collective: ’horse’ · also acc. sg., of a single horse in apposition to a name: ’the horse’ (Πήδασον … ἵππον ’Pedasus the horse’)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’)
ὀλοώτερος: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. nom. sg., comparative ὀλοώτερος: ’deadlier’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξύτατον: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; superl. ὀξύτατος; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’sharpest’
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀφθαλμῶν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the eyes’ · also masc. gen. pl. after κατά: ’down over the eyes’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν)
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὀϊλῆος: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, father of the lesser Ajax; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὁδοῦ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. gen. sg.
ὁδός: ὁδός — way, path, journey; fem. nom. sg.
ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
ὁμοκλητῆρος: ὁμοκλητήρ — one who calls out sharply, a rebuker or urger (ὁμοκλέω); masc. gen. sg., object of ἀκούσας
ὁμοκλὴν: ὁμοκλή — rebuke, threatening cry; fem. acc. sg.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅρα: ὁράω — see; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἑώρα)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. acc. pl.: ’all that’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὑπέρτατος: ὑπέρτατος — uppermost, topmost; superlative adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὑποδείσαντες: ὑποδείδω — fear, be afraid before; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., + acc.: ’fearing’
ὔμμες: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; nom. pl., epic ὔμμες (= Attic ὑμεῖς)
ὠκέες: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμω: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’two shoulders’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥῖνάς: ῥίς — nose, nostril (distinct from ῥινός ’skin, hide’); fem. acc. pl.
